assumptions.cost_source: illustrative assumptions, not an exchange fee quotation
assumptions.fill_model: next observed ask/bid plus assumed slippage; no queue model

manifest.disclosure: Results are normalized from the existing fixed-assumption simulator to $10-equivalent per case; no $10 wallets or native exchange bots are created.

limits: Cumulative retrospective replay of observations within a fixed forward collection window
Values normalized to 10 virtual USD-equivalent per case; no funded wallets
Assumes one USDC equals one USD; exchange minimum orders and actual fees unmodeled
No independent strategy validation and no evidence of future profit
